name: python-refactor
about: A rewrite of your Python module (solution.py) that still passes your tests and returns exactly what the original returns on every case you give.
instructions: Return the complete rewritten module. Keep every public function's name and signature.

original.about: the module as it is now

call.about: the function the cases call (its name in both modules)

cases.about: one call per line: a JSON array of the arguments (e.g. [3, [1, 2]]); cover the edge cases. Outputs must match exactly, so a change in float rounding counts
